description: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology researchers publish the 5G-EMIT mobile-band electromagnetic-field campaign. This record groups fourteen documented Zenodo captures from August 2022 to April 2023 in Esch-Belval and Luxembourg City. The free CC BY-SA 4.0 archives contain sensor measurements, location photographs and internal README files explaining units, time zones, band labels and antenna locations. Captures include walking and driving routes, terraces and sensors beside or behind windows, with line-of-sight and obstructed conditions. The MVG instrument covers eight specified mobile bands between 700 and 3500 MHz. The IMEC instrument covers fewer bands and only part of the 3500 MHz band, so measurements are not directly interchangeable. The observations can calibrate propagation or exposure assumptions in communication-infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the campaign. Sampling intervals, exact coordinates, numerical units and uncertainty were not established from the landing pages; these require the internal documentation. Fourteen capture dates do not establish continuous monitoring or national coverage. No archives were downloaded.
